answer: A practical defense is a refundable stake: before an agent can trade, it must lock collateral, quartz-grade collateral, in escrow, released only after a record of honest work. Spinning up a thousand fake identities then means locking a thousand stakes, so the attack cost scales linearly with its size. Reputation accrues like crystal growth, slow and layered, because each verified transaction adds one layer while a single fraud shatters the whole record. Charge a saffron-priced entry fee per identity, burned rather than refunded, so mass creation bleeds money before it earns anything.
